paragraphs: Nike, Inc. is an American athletic footwear and apparel corporation headquartered near Beaverton, Oregon. It is the world's largest supplier of athletic shoes and apparel and a major manufacturer of sports equipment, with revenue in excess of US$46 billion in its fiscal year 2022.

The company was founded on January 25, 1964, as "Blue Ribbon Sports", by Bill Bowerman and Phil Knight, and officially became Nike, Inc. on May 30, 1971. The company takes its name from Nike, the Greek goddess of victory. Nike markets its products under its own brand, as well as Nike Golf, Nike Pro, Nike+, Nike Blazers, Air Force 1, Nike Dunk, Air Max, Foamposite, Nike Skateboarding and Nike CR7. The company also sells products under its Air Jordan brand and its Converse subsidiary. Nike also owned Bauer Hockey from 1995 to 2008, and previously owned Cole Haan, Umbro, and Hurley International. In addition to manufacturing sportswear and equipment, the company operates retail stores under the Niketown name. Nike sponsors many high-profile athletes and sports teams around the world, with the highly recognized trademarks of "Just Do It" and the Swoosh logo.

As of 2024, it employed 83,700 people worldwide. In 2020, the brand alone was valued in excess of $32 billion, making it the most valuable brand among sports businesses. Previously, in 2017, the Nike brand was valued at $29.6 billion. Nike ranked 89th in the 2018 Fortune 500 list of the largest United States corporations by revenue. The company ranked 239th in the Forbes Global 2000 companies in 2024.

people.name: Mark Parker
people.title: Executive Chairman
people.bio: Served as President and Chief Executive Officer of NIKE from 2006 to 2020 before becoming Executive Chairman. His responsibilities at NIKE have included product research, design and development, marketing and brand management.
people.quote: Mark Parker , Executive Chairman - Mr. Parker, 70, joined NIKE in 1979

people.name: Elliott Hill
people.title: President and Chief Executive Officer
people.bio: Previously served as President - Consumer and Marketplace from 2018 until his retirement in 2020, leading commercial and marketing operations for the NIKE and Jordan brands. His earlier NIKE roles included President of Geographies and Sales and Vice President and General Manager of North America.
people.quote: Elliott Hill , President and Chief Executive Officer - Mr. Hill, 62, joined NIKE in 1988

people.name: Venkatesh Alagirisamy
people.title: Executive Vice President, Chief Operating Officer
people.bio: Leads NIKE's Global Supply Chain, Planning, Operations, Sustainability and Technology organizations. Previously served as Chief Supply Chain Officer, Chief Operating Officer for Converse, and Vice President of Global Operations & Express Lane.
people.quote: Venkatesh Alagirisamy , Executive Vice President, Chief Operating Officer - Mr. Alagirisamy, 50, joined NIKE in 2006

people.name: Matthew Friend
people.title: Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer
people.bio: Leads NIKE's strategy, finance and business services organizations and previously served as Vice President of Investor Relations and Chief Financial Officer of the NIKE Brand. The filing states he will cease serving as CFO on August 17, 2026, and serve as an advisor to the CEO until his separation on September 4, 2026.
people.quote: Matthew Friend , Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer (1) - Mr. Friend, 48, joined NIKE in 2009

people.name: Treasure Heinle
people.title: Executive Vice President, Chief People Officer
people.bio: Leads NIKE's global Human Resources function and its People vision and strategy, and previously served as Vice President, Chief Talent Officer. Before joining NIKE, held Human Resources leadership positions at Danaher Corporation, Tektronix, Inc. and InFocus Corporation.
people.quote: Treasure Heinle , Executive Vice President, Chief People Officer - Ms. Heinle, 56, joined NIKE in 2012

people.name: Robert Leinwand
people.title: Executive Vice President, Chief Legal Officer
people.bio: Previously served as NIKE's Vice President, Deputy General Counsel, Enterprise, overseeing functions including Global Litigation, Employment Law/Employee Relations, Brand Protection, Supply Chain and Corporate Governance. Before joining NIKE, was a shareholder at Littler Mendelson.
people.quote: Rob Leinwand , Executive Vice President, Chief Legal Officer - Mr. Leinwand, 58, joined NIKE in 2004

people.name: Phil McCartney
people.title: Executive Vice President, Chief Innovation, Design & Product Officer
people.bio: Oversees how NIKE, Jordan and Converse innovate, design and create products for athletes. Previously served as Vice President and General Manager of Global Footwear from 2016 and was a professional athlete before joining NIKE.
people.quote: Phil McCartney , Executive Vice President, Chief Innovation, Design & Product Officer - Mr. McCartney, 51, joined NIKE in 1998

people.name: Amy Montagne
people.title: President, Nike
people.bio: Previously served in Vice President and General Manager roles at NIKE, including APLA, Global Men's, Global Categories, Global Women's and Global Merchandising. Before joining NIKE, worked in allocation, planning and merchandising at Gap Inc., Mervyn's and Walmart Inc.
people.quote: Amy Montagne , President, Nike - Ms. M ontagne, 54, joined NIKE in 2005

people.name: Timothy Cook
people.title: Lead Independent Director
people.bio: Chief Executive Officer and a director of Apple, which he joined in 1998. Previously held positions at Compaq Computer Corporation, Intelligent Electronics, and International Business Machines Corporation.
people.quote: Mr. Cook is the Company's Lead Independent Director and is the Chief Executive Officer of Apple Inc.

people.name: Maria Henry
people.title: Director
people.bio: Former Chief Financial Officer of Kimberly-Clark, serving from 2015 to 2022. Serves on the boards of General Mills and NextEra Energy.
people.quote: Ms. Henry is the former Chief Financial Officer of Kimberly-Clark Corporation

people.name: Peter Henry
people.title: Director
people.bio: Class of 1984 Senior Fellow at Stanford University's Hoover Institution and Senior Fellow at Stanford's Freeman Spogli Institute for International Studies since September 2022. Dean Emeritus of New York University's Leonard N. Stern School of Business.
people.quote: Dr. Henry is the Class of 1984 Senior Fellow at Stanford University's Hoover Institution

people.name: Elliott Hill
people.title: President & Chief Executive Officer; Director
people.bio: President and Chief Executive Officer of NIKE. Previously worked at the Company from 1988 to 2020, serving as President of Consumer and Marketplace before retiring in 2020.
people.quote: Mr. Hill is President & Chief Executive Officer of the Company.

people.name: Travis Knight
people.title: Director
people.bio: President and Chief Executive Officer of LAIKA since 2009, having been involved in its principal creative and business decisions since its founding in 2003. Son of NIKE co-founder Philip Knight.
people.quote: Mr. Knight is the President and Chief Executive Officer of the animation studio, LAIKA, LLC

people.name: J rgen Vig Knudstorp
people.title: Director
people.bio: Former President and Chief Executive Officer of the LEGO Group from 2004 to 2016 and Executive Chairman of LEGO Brand Group from 2017 to 2023. Serves as a director and lead independent director of Starbucks.
people.quote: Mr. Knudstorp is the former President and Chief Executive Officer of the LEGO Group

people.name: Mark Parker
people.title: Chair of the Board
people.bio: Executive Chairman of NIKE's Board and former President and Chief Executive Officer from 2006 to January 2020. Has been employed by NIKE since 1979.
people.quote: Mr. Parker is Executive Chairman of the Company's Board of Directors.

people.name: Michelle Peluso
people.title: Director
people.bio: Chief Executive Officer of Revlon since 2024. Previously held executive roles at CVS Health and IBM and served as Chief Executive Officer of Gilt Groupe and Travelocity.
people.quote: Ms. Peluso is Chief Executive Officer of Revlon Group Holdings LLC

people.name: Thasunda Duckett
people.title: Director nominee
people.bio: President and Chief Executive Officer of the Teachers Insurance and Annuity Association of America.
people.quote: Ms. Duckett is President and Chief Executive Officer of the Teachers Insurance and Annuity Association of America

people.name: M nica Gil
people.title: Director nominee
people.bio: Named among the director nominees whom the Board determined to be independent.
people.quote: Timothy Cook, Thasunda Duckett, M nica Gil, Maria Henry, Peter Henry

people.name: Robert Swan
people.title: Director
people.bio: Chairs the Audit & Finance Committee. Named among the director nominees whom the Board determined to be independent.
people.quote: J rgen Vig Knudstorp, Michelle Peluso, and Robert Swan.

people.name: John Rogers, Jr.
people.title: Director (not standing for re-election)
people.bio: Chairman, Co-CEO, and Chief Investment Officer of Ariel Investments. Is not standing for re-election at the Annual Meeting.
people.quote: John Rogers, Jr., who is not standing for re-election at the Annual Meeting, is independent.
